steps.title: Configure App Meta Info
steps.description: Initialize app-meta.json with app name 'Native Image Text Replacer' and package 'com.nativeimagetextreplacer.app'.

steps.title: Define TextBlock Model
steps.description: Model class representing coordinate blocks, original detected text, and replacement styles.

steps.title: Create BrushStroke Model
steps.description: Model class representing points, dynamically calculated background colors, and radius for the Brush Remover tool.

steps.title: Create ImageOverlay Model
steps.description: Model class holding external overlay bitmaps and their coordinate bounds within the main image canvas.

steps.title: Implement Natural Background Reconstruction Algorithm
steps.description: Develop surrounding pixel sampling logic within EditorView to reconstruct canvas backgrounds dynamically when brushing.

steps.title: Implement Multi-Layer Canvas Rendering Pipeline
steps.description: Construct dynamic painting pipeline drawing the original image, brushed layers, replacement patches, and image overlays sequentially.

steps.title: Add Interactive Image Overlay Gestures
steps.description: Incorporate corner handles detection and touch translation to allow moving, resizing, and deleting overlaid images.

steps.title: Implement Drag & Drop Drop States
steps.description: Program Drag & Drop behavior with real-time updates and touch-down coordinates mapping for newly loaded overlay images.

steps.title: Design Mode Switcher and Control UI XML
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml layout with mode buttons for Text Editor, Brush Clean, and Image Overlays, along with specialized seekbars.

steps.title: Wire Main Activity View Controller
steps.description: Bind new toggle widgets, brush controllers, and file picks in MainActivity, using strict Java 8 compatible anonymous listeners.

steps.title: Implement High-Resolution Composite PNG Saver
steps.description: Construct low-level bitmap generator combining background, brushed paths, blocks, and overlays without rendering UI handles.

steps.title: Building Native Image Text Replacer
steps.description: Compile the code using Gradle 8.5 with AGP 8.3.2 inside the Temurin 17 Java environment.
